integrity: The proof is self-contained after the published definition and parameter symmetry; a standalone exact verifier checks the finite orbit reduction and rational extremal value.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the real Day–James hexagonal plane and the four-term constant defined in arXiv:2110.15741. No claim is made for other Day–James parameters or complex scalars. An unindexed duplicate calculation cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: Four-term von Neumann–Jordan profile of the Day–James hexagonal plane
